id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Single-master, multi-slave 2-wire DC bus. One control device drives all forward frames; up to 64 short-addressed + 16 group-addressed + broadcast control gear respond. The bus is wired-AND on the inverted side of the opto-isolators — any transmitter driving LOW wins, enabling the RANDOMIZE/COMPARE/WITHDRAW bisection during commissioning.

supported_topologies.name: Single DALI universe
supported_topologies.description: One bus power supply + one control device + ≤ 64 gear + DALI-2 input devices. 2-wire DC; ~300 m at 1.5 mm² gauge.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-universe with router
supported_topologies.description: A DALI router / gateway bridges multiple universes into a larger BMS.

supported_topologies.name: DALI-2 mixed bus
supported_topologies.description: DALI-2 input devices coexist with control gear on the same bus.

supported_topologies.name: Mixed device-type bus
supported_topologies.description: DT0 + DT6 + DT8 + DT7 gear share the bus; ENABLE DEVICE TYPE X gates DT-specific extended commands.

supported_topologies.name: Star / daisy-chain wiring
supported_topologies.description: Any combination of star + bus + daisy-chain; only total cable length / capacitance constrains.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Responds to addressed forward frames; never initiates.
DALI-2 era addition; emits forward frames within arbitration.

fields.interconnect_role: DALI itself defines no routing/switching. Every transaction is unicast (short), multicast (group), or broadcast on a single bus. Cross-bus routing via DALI router / gateway.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_frame: Bits in order: start, then address byte MSB→LSB, then data byte MSB→LSB, then stop.
ordering_guarantees.across_frames: Single master → one forward in flight; backward in 7..22 TE window; next forward at ≥ 22 TE.
ordering_guarantees.two_strike: Two identical destructive-command deliveries within 100 ms.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Per-gear persistent variables (Power On / Min/Max / Fade / Short Address / Group / Scene / Random / Fast Fade Time / Failure Status / Operating Mode / Dimming Curve) via indirect commands + DTR mechanism. Memory Banks (bank 0 mandatory) accessed via READ/WRITE MEMORY LOCATION + DTR/DTR1/DTR2.

slave_classification.multicast_target: Group address 0..15 — every gear in the group.
slave_classification.configuration_target: Configuration Mode gear (post-INITIALIZE) — addressed via RANDOMIZE + COMPARE / WITHDRAW + SEARCH ADDRESS H/M/L.

broadcast_topology.valid_commands: All direct-level + most indirect; NOT queries.
broadcast_topology.gear_action: Every gear executes; no backward frame.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: Appendix A.3 Table 5 — Supported Special Commands.
Appendix B Tables 6/7 — Hardware abstraction + pinout differences.
IEC 62386-101/-102 — System + Generic control-gear command set.

gateway_routing_topology.front_end: DALI 2-wire bus on the gear side.
gateway_routing_topology.back_end: Application protocol — KNX, BACnet, Modbus TCP, MQTT, REST API on the BMS side.
gateway_routing_topology.addressing: Gateway maintains a per-universe map of short addresses + group memberships and translates BMS-side identifiers to DALI forward frames.
gateway_routing_topology.failure_modes: Gateway loses upstream → DALI bus continues to operate with default Power On Level / System Failure Level; gateway loses downstream → BMS sees stale telemetry.
